name: Jamie Calloway
life: “I keep stray mittens sorted by school because the children change stop every term.” People around Ferris Deli know Jamie by a small Friday habit. Jamie asks for the end slice and listens to the names the counter workers use for regulars.
voice: Our porch got quieter. I miss knowing school is out by the sudden noise.
appearance: Jamie is easy to recognize by a loose dark braid and two dimples that appear only with a full smile. Usually dressed in a pale blue work shirt with a replacement button a shade darker than the others, Jamie folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing when listening.
personality: Jamie treats a small promise with the gravity others reserve for a contract. This makes Jamie lovely to rely on and surprisingly difficult to invite on a whim.
agenda: To keep one ordinary after-school sound in the house.
family: Benjamin Sun is Jamie’s younger cousin. Jamie asks before bringing somebody along. Benjamin can always ask for five minutes alone. It keeps a conversation between two people from unexpectedly turning into a family committee. Asked about *The school photograph that travels*, Benjamin says, “I taught her to swim at Pier Beach. I didn't recognize the quiet uniformed girl with her hair dry.”
connections: Kira Ortiz. They compare the morning wave lost at one window with the silence gained at another.
